title.narrative: KHM-RS-010 GCF readiness support of accreditation of Direct Access Entity to private banks

description.narrative: The overarching objective of the project is to strengthen Cambodia's readiness to access climate finance, particularly from the GCF. By enhancing institutional capacity, fostering stakeholder coordination, and developing bankable project ideas, the project seeks to empower Cambodia to address climate change challenges effectively. Ultimately, the project aims to contribute to Cambodia's sustainable development goals by enabling the implementation of climate-resilient initiatives across various sectors.

The project focuses on building Cambodia's readiness to access climate finance through the GCF. It involves capacity-building activities, institutional coordination, and the development of bankable project ideas. GGGI, as the DP, leads project implementation, ensuring compliance with GCF policies. The project aims to enhance Cambodia's ability to address climate change challenges effectively.

Strengthening the capacity of private banks in Cambodia for on-lending and blending fiduciary functions results in enhanced access to the Green Climate Fund (GCF). This is achieved through the establishment of at least one nominated private entities equipped with the necessary systems and standards for GCF accreditation. This accreditation process support fosters the creation of enabling conditions for the development of an investment pipeline comprising low-carbon and climate-resilient projects, as well as the generation of project ideas eligible for concept note formulation.

description.narrative: Support at least 1 nominated DAE in the preparation and assessment of all documents for submission of the GCF accreditation application.
